text_block_list.text:
Duramente and Air Groove used to attend 
this Umamusume school as children. Now, 
the two of them were giving instructions 
to its students.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Your arm swing is too small. Increasing 
your range of motion should give you more 
propulsion."

text_block_list.name: Student Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
? Range of moshun...? Propulsyun 
powur...???

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... For example, when playing on 
a swing, the further back you pull, the 
faster you move forward, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Running is the same way. If you don't 
swing your arms wide, you won't be able to 
propel yourself forward with all your 
might.

text_block_list.name: Student Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see...! On a swing, when you pull back 
you go whoosh! Yeah, I'll try it!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, pay it no mind. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Giving easy-to-understand examples and 
explaining things logically. As expected 
of you, Big Sis Groove."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing. As the "Empress," it is 
merely my natural duty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, back to teaching. Students who are 
still buds are waiting for us.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's everything cleaned up. 
...Come to think of it, where is 
Duramente? I don't see her anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were. ...Hm? What are 
you doing?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Big Sis Groove... No, never mind—
(Flap!)

Perhaps startled, Duramente dropped her 
notebook to the ground. As I picked it up, 
an open page caught my eye.

"Knowledge on being the 'strongest': If 
your opponent is a child, provide optimal 
guidance."

"If one is truly the 'strongest', they 
must be able to guide others to draw out 
their full potential, not just their own. 
I shall look to Sister Groove as an 
example."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What was that? ...Don't tell me you're 
doing the exact same thing as me?
choice_data_list: Do you know anything about this?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, I used to keep a journal 
too. Titled 'The Principles of Being an 
Empress.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Physical prowess, academics, deportment... 
What do I lack to truly be an "Empress"? 
These notes were written for my own 
self-reflection.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... Dura. To think you were doing the 
exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Until the day I became the 'strongest,' 
I wanted to keep this hidden from you, my 
benefactor.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
'The Strongest' and 'The Empress.' Even if 
our destinations differed, I have always 
watched you... upholding your ideals.

text_block_list.name: Young Groove
text_block_list.text:
Instructing the academy students as a 
substitute...? Understood, leave it to me. 
I have a complete grasp of all their 
strengths and weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text:
(To take over for Teacher with such 
absolute confidence...! And she's just a 
student, like me!)

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text:
...? Sister Groove dropped something... 
"Principles of Being an 'Empress'"...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Reading what she wrote about her 
self-reflection... it felt like a jolt of 
electricity ran through me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was after that that I began keeping a 
journal, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Allowing zero compromises for the sake of 
your own ambition. ...I have watched you 
do that all along.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Your back, steadily walking toward your 
ideals... Even now, it remains my 
unwavering guide.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
! ...I, see. That is something to be proud 
of.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Using me as your guidepost... you've grown 
into such a splendid Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove...! Yes, I'll work even 
harder!
choice_data_list:
You really still look up to them, don't 
you?

You really still look up to them, don't 
you?
Let's keep learning a lot from her!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove...! Yes, I'll work even 
harder!
choice_data_list:
You really still look up to them, don't 
you?

You really still look up to them, don't 
you?
Let's keep learning a lot from her!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Ever since we were young, 
everyone has trusted Sis Groove... She's 
who I aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You give me too much credit"... is what I 
want to say, but for now, I'll take the 
compliment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"After all, right in front of me is an 
Umamusume who looks up to me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're right. But... she's also someone I 
have to surpass one day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, bold words. Did you really think it 
would be so easy to surpass me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I do not think so. However... if that is 
the path to becoming the "strongest," then 
without fail.
